request.name: Create A Collection With Vector Fields

description.content: Creates a collection that includes vector embedding fields for semantic search. Vector fields are defined with a type of float[] and a num_dim property specifying the number of dimensions. The embed property can be used to configure automatic embedding generation from source fields using built-in models or external APIs like OpenAI.

info.name: Typesense Analytics Analytics Events Vector Collections API

description.content:
The Typesense Analytics API allows developers to track and analyze search behavior by recording click, conversion, and visit events. It provides endpoints for creating analytics rules, logging events with metadata tags, and retrieving popular queries and queries with no results. This data can be used to improve search relevance through query suggestions, curations, and understanding user search patterns.
